pix/host/cli._prod_loc_note: 475 -> 502: Deps.Config() now warns about config keys this build ignores, so a typo is surfaced instead of silently doing nothing. A deliberate, reviewed raise of a shrink-only budget, which is the only way this number is allowed to move.

pix/host/health._prod_loc_note: prod_loc 1262 -> 1291: raised together for ONE change: `pix doctor` and `pix setup` demanded an anthropic/openai/google key from hosts whose models need none. A pack's sbx-session backends carry their own credential (a Docker login session the sbx proxy injects inside the sandbox, unreplayable from the host by design), so the key store lists nothing and the required row went red prescribing `pix models add anthropic` — a key nothing would read. `pix run`'s launch gate already skipped the key check on exactly this host (inference.ConfiguredKeylessInference); ProviderKeyProbe.Keyless + inference.KeylessBackends give the same carve-out to the two verbs that lacked it, so all three stop disagreeing about one host. Distinct from Callable, which answers "this key routes nowhere"; Keyless answers "no key was ever the credential". A deliberate, reviewed raise of a shrink-only budget.

pix/host/secret._prod_loc_note: 1240 -> 1290, exports 42 -> 43, globals 8 -> 9: web-search TOOL keys (ToolKeyRefOrder) are now seeded/checked/mirrored like model-provider keys, but held OUT of ProviderKeyRefOrder and ModelProviders so `pix models add` never offers a name it would reject and a missing search key can never refuse a launch. The new export is the list itself; the new global is the sync map, now DERIVED from both lists so an entry cannot be added to one and forgotten in the other. A deliberate, reviewed raise of a shrink-only budget.

pix/host/workflow/doctor._prod_loc_note: raised together for ONE change: `pix doctor` reported model keys from the sbx secret store as if they were routable, so a host with three keys but one probed binding showed three green providers while every intent that preferred another vendor silently fell back. ProviderKeyProbe.Callable + inference.CallableProviders make key-present-but-unrouted visible (nil = not computed, which preserves the old report). A deliberate, reviewed raise of a shrink-only budget.

pix/host/workflow/launch._prod_loc_note: 2458 -> 2503, exports 109 -> 112: personal context (skills + standing AGENTS.md) is now mounted unconditionally at the context ROOT, so a session can write its FIRST skill from inside the sandbox and keep the whole dir in git. Previously the mount was gated on the dir already having entries, which made the first skill impossible to author in-sandbox, and only skills/ was mounted, so AGENTS.md was invisible. New exports: MountDirs (the mount set, now distinct from the skill set), PersonalSkillsDir (one spelling shared by loader and mount), EnsurePersonalContextDir. A deliberate, reviewed raise of a shrink-only budget.

pix/host/workflow/models._prod_loc_note: 1084 -> 1091: `models add` no longer tells the user to run `pix models route`. That was busywork presented as a required step: every `pix run` already recompiles the intent map from current bindings. The line now states that routing updates itself. A deliberate, reviewed raise of a shrink-only budget.
